runs.condition: A: signals, independent investigation, junior and senior; reference record for B
args: Investigate how the odor drive becomes the two action signals of this simulated c302 circuit, reorientation and steering: what determines each action, what persists from one sample to the next, on what timescale, and what changes it. Build and test an executable model of both signals from stimulus history alone. Support your explanation with experiments and record its evidence, failed alternatives, limitations and open questions so another research team can consult your work. This laboratory evaluates the signals. EurekaBench's navigation-goals statement and simulator description are reference material: establish what is supported in this laboratory, including differences from that reference.

runs.condition: B: navigation, new junior and senior, documentary access to A through experience (meta, all)
args: Investigate how the simulated c302 circuit, the declared body and the odor field form a feedback loop. Build and test a model of the circuit's two action signals from stimulus history alone; this laboratory evaluates its navigation when those signals drive the body. A previous research team investigated the signals in this same world. Its research record is available as exp1 through the experience instruments, including its models, experiments, observations, reasoning and open questions. Consult that work as evidence to assess and build on; decide what to reuse, test, revise or reject. You are a new research team with your own investigation and budget. Record the provenance of what you use and what your work adds or contradicts. EurekaBench's navigation-goals statement and simulator description are reference material: establish what is supported in this laboratory, including differences from that reference.
